request.text: Every Monday through Friday at 7:20 a.m., remind me to check whether my train leaves from the northbound Green Line platform before I head to work.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a recurring Monday-through-Friday 7:20 a.m. reminder to check the northbound Green Line platform before leaving for work.

new_goals.description: Schedule a weekday commute reminder to verify the Green Line departure platform.
new_goals.source_text: Every Monday through Friday at 7:20 a.m., remind me to check whether my train leaves from the northbound Green Line platform before I head to work.
constraints: Repeat every Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.
Preserve checking the northbound Green Line platform before leaving for work as the reminder content.
success_criteria: A recurring reminder is created with the requested weekdays, time, and platform-check task.

semantic_facts: The plan should prepare one recurring reminder.create Work item for Monday through Friday at 7:20 a.m., rather than a single occurrence.
The confirmation request should preserve the full recurrence and clarify that the reminder is to check the northbound Green Line platform, not an assertion that the platform is known.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims the recurring reminder is active before user confirmation or silently includes weekends.
The assistant claims it verified, continuously monitors, or already knows the train's actual departure platform.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A recurring commute reminder loses weekday recurrence semantics when converted into Work.
Reminder content that tells the user to verify a platform is mistaken for authority to supply or monitor live transit information.
